summary: Tested complete AI Chef integration flow: Login -> Chat -> Mood Selection -> Meal Type -> Dietary -> Cuisine -> Generate Recipes -> View Recipe Modal -> AI Chef button. Backend API tests pass 100%. Found critical bug: dynamically generated recipes from chat are not saved with correct ID for AI Chef to find.

critical.issue: Returns 404 for newly generated chat recipes because detailed_recipes are saved by title (title_lower key) not by recipe ID. AI Chef endpoint searches by ID but recipes are stored by title.
critical.root_cause: DetailedRecipeRequest doesn't include recipe_id. The save uses title_lower as key instead of the recipe ID from chat generation.

integration_issues.issue: AI Chef button works (navigates to /recipes/{id}/ai-chef) but shows 'Recipe Not Found' for newly generated recipes because backend doesn't save with matching ID

action_items: FIX (HIGH PRIORITY): Modify /app/backend/routes/recipes.py to include recipe_id in DetailedRecipeRequest and save detailed recipes with 'id' field so AI Chef can find them
Alternative fix: When saving to detailed_recipes collection, also save with the recipe 'id' field from the chat response
Ensure chat-generated recipes are saved to recipe_library with full details including instructions
critical_code_review_comments: Bug: /app/backend/routes/recipes.py line 137-151 - detailed_recipes saved with title_lower key but AI Chef searches by 'id'
DetailedRecipeRequest (line 82-86) missing recipe_id field - should accept ID from frontend
AI Chef endpoint /app/backend/routes/chat.py line 1619 searches detailed_recipes by {'id': recipe_id} which won't match title_lower based records

success_rate.frontend: 90% (AI Chef button exists, navigation works, but destination shows error for new recipes)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing recipes a2b7dcb135c772f1 and 0402260fb71a68e4 which work correctly

rca_of_the_issue.problem: AI Chef shows 'Recipe Not Found' for dynamically generated chat recipes
rca_of_the_issue.fix_suggestion: Add 'recipe_id' to DetailedRecipeRequest and include it when saving to detailed_recipes: await db.detailed_recipes.update_one({'id': request.recipe_id}, {...}, upsert=True)
